plans.idea: Classic banner read left to right: product box anchors the left, the big '30% OFF' headline and subcopy fill the right column, with the CTA left-aligned under the copy on the same edge and the brand badge and small lines in a quiet strip at the bottom.

Copy-first mirror: headline, subcopy and CTA stacked on one shared left edge, so the offer is read first, with the product box large on the right and the brand badge and eyebrow sitting next to the CTA.

Three-column strip: product on the left, a wide centered headline block in the middle, and an action column on the right where the CTA sits vertically centered with the brand badge and fine print stacked under it, clear of the canvas edge.
